## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Schema change (see checklist below)
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Docs / tests only

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated for every changed behaviour
- [ ] All tests pass (`pnpm turbo test`)
- [ ] TypeScript passes (`pnpm turbo typecheck`)
- [ ] Changeset added (`pnpm changeset`) — required for any user-facing change
- [ ] `SCHEMA.md` updated if block types, slots, or Zod schemas changed

## Schema change checklist (if applicable)

- [ ] New/changed schemas have Zod validators
- [ ] `SCHEMA.md` updated with new fields and examples
- [ ] `migrate()` function updated if this is a breaking schema change
- [ ] `deck.schema.json` will be regenerated by build
